utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ll be there at 10 on the porch. What should I prioritize first, greeting people or sorting the tools?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Start with greeting people, then we can sort the tools as they come in. That’ll keep the porch moving and make it easy for folks to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. I can help out, and I’ll ask around for anyone else who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Oren. It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the role list once I finish it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Vik. Keep me posted, and I’ll be ready to help with parking or tool drop-off once the plan is set.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. I’ll keep you posted once the plan’s firmed up, and parking or tool drop-off would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps. I can ask around, but I still want to make sure the parking and tool drop-off by the porch are clearly marked first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m on it — I’ll make sure the parking and tool drop-off by the front porch are clearly marked before Saturday, and I’m still lining up a few more helpers for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Just a quick update, Vik: the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the front porch. I’m sorting out the roles now, so I’ll send you the details shortly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, thanks, Rosa. I’ll wait for your details and keep the Sunday community center plan in mind.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask around, but I want to be sure the parking and tool drop-off by the porch are clearly marked first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll help with the porch signs and I can ask a few more people too. Just tell me where you want the parking and tool drop-off marked.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
